nodes.title: Averaged Cauchy products of convergent sequences

nodes.summary: Let $(a_k)$ and $(b_k)$ be real sequences such that the series $\sum_{k=0}^{\infty} a_k x^k$ and $\sum_{k=0}^{\infty} b_k x^k$ converge absolutely for every real $x$ with $|x| < 1$. If $\sum_{k=0}^{\infty} a_k x^k = \sum_{k=0}^{\infty} b_k x^k$ for $x = 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, \dots$, then $a_k = b_k$ for all $k \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Power series agreeing at $1/2, 1/3, 1/4, \dots$ have equal coefficients

nodes.summary: Let $a_0, a_1, a_2, \dots$ and $b_0, b_1, b_2, \dots$ be complex numbers with $1 + |a_k| \le |b_k|$ for every $k$. For $n \ge 0$ let $f_n$ be the $n$-th approximant of the continued fraction $a_0 / (b_0 + a_1 / (b_1 + \cdots))$, that is $f_0 = 0$ and $f_n = a_0 / (b_0 + a_1 / (b_1 + \cdots + a_{n-1} / b_{n-1}))$ for $n \ge 1$. nodes.title: Śleszyński–Pringsheim convergence criterion

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ and $\beta$ be real numbers. For $k \in \mathbb{N}$ let $x_k = (\alpha, \beta) \in \mathbb{R} \times \mathbb{R}$ if $k$ is even and $x_k = (\beta, \alpha)$ if $k$ is odd. For $n \in \mathbb{N}$ let $s_n = \sum_{k=1}^{n} k^{-2} x_k$ (so $s_0 = 0$). Then the sequence $(s_n)$ converges in $\mathbb{R} \times \mathbb{R}$.
nodes.title: Convergence of an alternating weighted series in the plane
Limits of specific sequences and partial sums

nodes.summary: Monotone functions on a closed interval with a continuous pointwise limit converge uniformly. Let $a < b$ be real numbers, let $f_n : [a, b] \to \mathbb{R}$, $n \in \mathbb{N}$, be nondecreasing functions, and let $g : [a, b] \to \mathbb{R}$ be continuous with $f_n(x) \to g(x)$ for every $x \in [a, b]$. Then $g$ is nondecreasing and $f_n \to g$ uniformly on $[a, b]$.
nodes.title: Monotone functions on a closed interval with a continuous pointwise limit converge uniformly
Normal convergence of series of functions

nodes.summary: Let $(a_n)_{n \ge 0}$ and $(b_n)_{n \ge 0}$ be sequences of real numbers such that $(b_n)$ is strictly increasing and $b_n \to +\infty$ as $n \to \infty$, and let $L$ be a real number. If $\frac{a_{n+1} - a_n}{b_{n+1} - b_n} \to L$ as $n \to \infty$, then $\frac{a_n}{b_n} \to L$ as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Stolz–Cesàro theorem

nodes.summary: Let $b$, $c$ and $x$ be complex numbers such that $c + kb \neq 0$ for every integer $k \ge 1$. Then the series $\sum_{j=0}^{\infty} \frac{(-b)^j x^{j+1}}{\prod_{k=1}^{j+1} (c + kb)}$ is summable.
nodes.title: Summability of a rising-product series

nodes.summary: For all real numbers $a < b$ there is a function $g : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ such that the partial sums $\sum_{n=1}^{N} \bigl(1 - \cos(x/n)\bigr)$ converge to $g(x)$ uniformly for $x \in [a, b]$ as $N \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Uniform convergence of $\sum (1 - \cos(x/n))$ on compact intervals

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
